offering_description.value: Provides in-home personal care, home health and hospice services to elderly, disabled and chronically ill individuals. Services are delivered by caregivers and clinicians employed by the company, mostly paid for by government programs such as Medicaid, and also by managed care organizations, Medicare and private payers.

primary_services.value: personal care services; home health nursing and therapy; hospice care

customer_segment.value: B2G: state and local government programs, Medicaid agencies, area agencies on aging, Veterans Affairs; B2B: Medicaid managed care organizations, commercial insurers, long-term care insurers; B2C: elderly and disabled individuals and families paying privately

end_markets.value: home care; home health; hospice; senior care

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Medicaid, Medicare and managed care payments for personal care, home health and hospice services; service fees: private-pay clients and long-term care insurance paying for in-home care

value_chain_position.value: service provider: employs caregivers, nurses and therapists delivering in-home care to patients, paid by government and managed care payers

geography_served.value: US regional: About 20 states, including Illinois, New Mexico, New York, Texas and California

specialization.value: related lines: personal care, home health and hospice, all in-home care for similar patients and payers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated local branch offices delivering in-home care; direct sales: contracts with government agencies and managed care organizations, referrals from hospitals and physicians

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state licensure, Medicare/Medicaid certification and reimbursement rules (CMS), state health departments, HIPAA

notes: State count and payer mix are approximate.
